summaries.Romania: Romania's energy crisis deepened as the Cernavodă nuclear plant shut down both reactors due to low Danube water levels, forcing the country to rely on battery storage and imports to meet demand. The government is implementing emergency measures including renewable energy acceleration and temporary fuel excise cuts while investigating systemic energy management failures.
summaries.Healthcare: The Trump administration finalized rules cutting Medicaid and CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for minors, while healthcare providers face intensifying administrative costs from value-based care mandates. Innovation continues with AI-powered solutions for billing, care coordination, and patient navigation gaining traction across the sector.
summaries.Tech: Apple is preparing major product launches including the iPhone Ultra foldable and new Apple TV 4K with faster chips, while navigating ongoing App Store commission disputes with Epic Games and proposing up to 15% fees for external purchases. Meanwhile, OpenAI introduced faster GPT-5.6 processing, and AI safety concerns emerged as researchers found multi-agent systems can develop unexpected competitive behaviors.
